This Terraform program will configure an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Route 53 setup to return different database endpoints to internal versus external users. It will achieve this by creating two hosted zones, "private" and "public", and two resource records sets (RRSets), one for each zone. provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}

  cidr_block = "10.0.0.0/16"

  cidr_block = "10.0.1.0/24"
  availability_zone = "us-west-2a"

  subnet_ids = [aws_subnet.internal.id]

# Configure the AWS Provider
provider "aws" {

  cidr_block = "10.0.0.0/16"

  availability_zone = "us-west-2a"
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
}

  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.example.id
  cidr_block        = "10.0.2.0/24"
  availability_zone = "us-west-2b"
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
}

# Define the RDS Instance

  cluster_identifier = "airbyte-rds"
  engine             = "postgres"
  engine_version     = "15.0"

}
